scientific.integrity: The two-class reduction follows the published Reinhardt optimizer and cyclotomic criterion, independently checked exhaustively at n=9. Both exact areas and the gap were independently reconstructed from geometry and algebra.
limitations: The complete 2011 enumeration article was not accessible for full-text comparison; absence of a matching area formula therein is not asserted.
The global odd-polygon area maximizer and the two perimeter-optimal congruence classes are prior results.
This assessment provides no human expert attestation or formal Lean proof.

title: Complete area spectrum of maximum-perimeter diameter-one nonagons
